race.comment: BUTTERSCOTCH (3) clearly on top. She'd shown ability last time in but has come back better with a dominant maiden win here first up over 1400m, drawing clear to score by 2.25 lengths. Bred to get further, she should improve out to a mile and will take plenty of beating again. BOGUES (2) resumes from a short spell, now with the Goodwin yard who are good with these sorts of horses. He was racing well last time in and Lane hops aboard, watch the betting. OSHIMA (1) didn't take long to break the maiden, scoring nicely here over this route at his second start. No reason he can't go on with it. LADY ELSA (6) has been solid in two runs back here and should be ready to peak.
